question: Is the site's datum a deterministic weighted sum of its lines' constants, rather than a mean over lines with a between-line SE?

inputs.role: each flight line's share of the GROUND CELLS the pipeline built for this tile -- the weights w_i
open-ground per-line marks and ties at this site

params.name: sigma_mark_mm
params.why: within-line sd of a mark about its own line mean, measured on 25 open marks across 18 lines out to 40 km; the per-mark scatter that sets var(c_i) = sigma_mark^2 / n_i

params.name: unknown_line_treatment
params.why: a line with no mark has an unknown constant; renormalising its weight away ASSUMES it behaves like the others, so the alternative -- charging it the full between-line variance -- is reported beside it

columns.w: that line's share of the tile's ground cells, 0-1
columns.n_marks: open control marks on that line, count
columns.c_mm: that line's mean tie, mm; blank if no mark
columns.var_c_mm2: variance of that line's constant, mm^2 = sigma_mark^2/n
columns.value: its value; mm unless the name says otherwise

headline: weighted +69.99 +/- 22.75 (renorm) vs mean-over-lines +62.74 +/- 23.38
